def all_subsets(values):
    subsets = []

    def all_subsets_helper(curr_arr, index):
        pad = '  ' * index
        print(f'{pad}ENTER helper(curr_arr={curr_arr}, index={index})')

        if index == len(values):
            subsets.append(curr_arr[:])
            print(f'{pad}  BASE CASE -> append {curr_arr[:]} to subsets')
            print(f'{pad}EXIT  helper(curr_arr={curr_arr}, index={index})')
            return

        print(f'{pad}  -- line A: about to call helper({curr_arr + [values[index]]}, {index+1})')
        all_subsets_helper(curr_arr + [values[index]], index + 1)
        print(f'{pad}  -- line A call above is now fully done, moving to line B')

        print(f'{pad}  -- line B: about to call helper({curr_arr}, {index+1})')
        all_subsets_helper(curr_arr, index + 1)
        print(f'{pad}  -- line B call above is now fully done')

        print(f'{pad}EXIT  helper(curr_arr={curr_arr}, index={index})')

    all_subsets_helper([], 0)
    return subsets

all_subsets([1, 2, 3])
